name: Separation In Marriage
overview: Scripture teaches that marriage is intended as a lifelong union, with separation or putting away a spouse being strongly discouraged except in the case of sexual immorality. Jesus clarifies that Moses permitted divorce because of human hardness of heart, but from the beginning, God did not intend for marriage to be dissolved. The Lord hates putting away, warning believers to guard their hearts against treachery in marital relationships. Those who divorce except for fornication and remarry commit adultery, underscoring the sacredness and permanence of the marital covenant.
